title: Valid Parentheses
contract: The input contains only ()[]{}. Return whether brackets are correctly nested.
brute: while(!s.isEmpty()){String next=s.replace("()", "").replace("[]", "").replace("{}", "");emit("Remove adjacent matching pairs","remaining",next);if(next.equals(s))return false;s=next;}return true;
optimal: Deque<Character> stack=new ArrayDeque<>();for(char c:s.toCharArray()){if(c=='('||c=='['||c=='{')stack.push(c);else{if(stack.isEmpty())return false;char open=stack.pop();if((c==')'&&open!='(')||(c==']'&&open!='[')||(c=='}'&&open!='{'))return false;}emit("Track unmatched opening brackets","character",c,"stack",stack);}return stack.isEmpty();
reasoning: Repeatedly remove innermost pairs; valid nesting eventually reduces to nothing.
A closing bracket must match the most recent unmatched opener: exactly the LIFO rule.
Reject empty-stack closes immediately, and require an empty stack after the scan. Counting each bracket type is insufficient to validate nesting.
